title: Cy Twombly: The Last Paintings

description.main: Catalogue of the last paintings Cy Twombly completed, shown at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, in 2012.
description.extended:
The catalogue of the last paintings Cy Twombly completed, eight untitled works first shown at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, the year after his death.

Plates and detail images reproduce each painting. Achim Hochdörfer, who curated Cy Twombly: States of Mind at the Museum Moderner Kunst Stiftung Ludwig Wien in 2009, and the curator Julie Sylvester contribute new essays. A photo essay by Sally Mann records Twombly's home and studio. After Beverly Hills the exhibition travelled to Hong Kong, London, and New York. Graphic Thought Facility, London, designed the book, and Shapco Printing, Minneapolis, printed it. A grey dust jacket lettered in orange covers boards that reproduce one of the paintings.

The paintings keep the bold colour and loose, exuberant marks of Twombly's late work. Sylvester also curated the Hermitage survey of his drawings, whose catalogue, Fifty Years of Works on Paper, is in the library.

notes: Catalogue of the exhibition at Gagosian, Beverly Hills, which travelled to Hong Kong, London, and New York. Hardcover in dust jacket. Printed by Shapco Printing, Minneapolis.
